rationale: Jake and Dhanush are both founder-roboticists working at different layers of the robotics stack—Jake is building robot hardware (his first arm) while deeply convicted on infrastructure and low-level compute optimization, and Dhanush is a full-stack roboticist focused on perception and software architecture with hands-on expertise in ROS, OpenCV, and C++. They share the robotics-manipulation domain and could explore how Jake's infrastructure-first philosophy and Dhanush's perception + architecture expertise might complement each other, especially as robotics moves toward autonomous AI agents.
intro_message: Jake Fitzgerald, meet Dhanush Baktha — both founder-roboticists building at different parts of the stack (hardware + infrastructure vs. perception + software architecture) who could explore how low-level optimization and ROS-based perception work together in autonomous systems.
